title: Find the deadlock
description:
Detect a deadlock from who holds and who waits for which lock.

```
A holds m1, waits for m2
B holds m2, waits for m3
C holds m3, waits for m1
deadlock: A -> B -> C -> A
```
hints: Since each thread waits for at most one lock, following the chain until you see a thread twice is enough.
requirements: Build a wait-for graph: an edge from a thread to the thread holding the lock it waits for.
Find a cycle with a depth-first search and print it.
Suggest the fix: always take locks in one order.
stretch: Add timeouts: a thread that waited too long gives up its locks and the cycle breaks.
